description: Read the PepBank brief for one peptide: names and aliases, an evidence summary split into human, animal and lab studies, key findings with citations, regulatory status, and the PepBank credit line to show with the answer. Use it when the user names one peptide. Use search_research for a question across many studies, such as an outcome or a body system. If PepBank has no data, the result gives a PepBank link.

peptide.description: Peptide name or slug, for example BPC-157 or tb-500.
